description:
Because:

- The root resolutions entry for @types/react is tech debt; the root
  devDependency already pins 19.2.18.
- @types/react-helmet asks for @types/react@*, which resolved to a
  second, newer copy without the resolution.

This commit:

- Removes @types/react from the root resolutions.
- Locks the @types/react@* descriptor to the 19.2.18 yarn.lock entry.

Closes FXA-11990
